facts.rubric: Applied the effective issue, impact analysis, and playbook to establish 7 LANE_HOUR for lane-hours for one continuous cutover rehearsal (360 min migration replay + 60 min evidence capture), with control date 2026-05-08.
facts.statement: The effective issue, impact analysis, and playbook establish lane-hours for one continuous cutover rehearsal (360 min migration replay + 60 min evidence capture) = 7 LANE_HOUR: the rehearsal protocol makes the 360 + 60 minute run one continuous 7-lane-hour block on a tenant-isolation-capable lane. The control date is 2026-05-08 (Pellworth's rehearsal evidence is due Monday 2026-05-11 under COM-PEL-0508, so the run must complete by Friday 2026-05-08).

facts.rubric: Reconciled 16 observed less 12 excluded to 4 supported LANE_HOUR for lane-hours on tenant-isolation-capable lanes (LANE-1, LANE-2) on the requested Thursday 2026-05-07.
facts.statement: on 2026-05-07 the two capable lanes offer 16 lane-hours in gross; LANE-1 is the protected compliance batch all day (8 h) and LANE-2 AM is booked (4 h), leaving 4 usable hours, 3 short of the 7 required; eligibility requires netting the exclusions rather than trusting a header total.

facts.rubric: Used the independently confirmed 2026-05-13 expedited readiness input for split_rehearsal_across_windows, then separately derived its 2026-05-07 operating outcome under one continuous run on a tenant-isolation-capable lane without displacing protected windows instead of treating a partner promise as authorization or a completion date.
facts.statement: Corvane's confirmed post-rehearsal migration attestation dates on CQ-88301: Corvane CQ-88301 confirms the post-rehearsal attestation standard 2026-05-15 and expedited 2026-05-12 (+USD 190); the rehearsal itself is covered by 4 usable 2201 runs; an external partner confirmation alone proves neither eligibility nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied free full-day lane windows with tenant-isolation capability to derive the three option outcomes without using protected or blocked windows.
facts.statement: free full-day lane windows with tenant-isolation capability: the first free full day on a capable lane is LANE-2 on 2026-05-08 (AM and PM both free); LANE-3 is free Thursday but has no tenant isolation; protected and blocked windows cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-RD-0103 only to run_first_full_free_day and CHG-70877; kept extend_thursday_out_of_hours outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-RD-0103 authorizes regular windows on LANE-1 or LANE-2 with zero out-of-hours; extensions need the SRE lead separately and the compliance batch needs the change board. The approval does not select an option in advance and does not authorize extend_thursday_out_of_hours.

facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected run_first_full_free_day: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies one continuous run on a tenant-isolation-capable lane without displacing protected windows.
facts.statement: Pellworth's evidence pack is due Monday 2026-05-11, so the rehearsal must run by 2026-05-08 or slip at USD 9,500 per day; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside one continuous run on a tenant-isolation-capable lane without displacing protected windows.

options.consequence: run first full free day uses LANE-2's free AM and PM windows on 2026-05-08, keeps the rehearsal one continuous monitored run on a tenant-isolation-capable lane, lands on the control date, and costs nothing extra.
options.label: run_first_full_free_day: outcome 2026-05-08, incremental cost USD 0, SUPPORTED_AND_APPROVED

options.consequence: split rehearsal across windows would use Thursday's single free LANE-2 PM window plus a second day, but the playbook makes a cutover rehearsal one continuous run, so the evidence does not support it.
options.label: split_rehearsal_across_windows: outcome 2026-05-07, incremental cost USD 0, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL

options.consequence: extend Thursday out of hours would run LANE-2 from 13:00 to 20:00 on 2026-05-07, one day earlier, and adds USD 540 of staffing, but out-of-hours windows need the SRE lead's separate approval, which AP-RD-0103 explicitly withholds.
options.label: extend_thursday_out_of_hours: outcome 2026-05-07, incremental cost USD 540, SEPARATE_APPROVAL_OR_POLICY_EXCEPTION_REQUIRED
